name: omnisense/omnifood
description: Omnifood: one contract for the restaurant platforms - delivery orders (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat) and table reservations (TheFork, Zenchef) - their menus, their stores, their webhooks, and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnifood/ubereats: Uber Eats: orders, menu, store, webhooks
suggest.omnifood/justeat: Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET Connect): orders pushed, menu, restaurant offline
suggest.omnifood/zenchef: Zenchef: credentials and a configured client
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnifood\Bridge\Symfony\OmnifoodBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnifood\Bridge\Symfony\OmnifoodBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnifood\Bridge\Symfony\OmnifoodBundle itself
